# NeoBrutal Rivet

> NeoBrutal Rivet is a public-alpha neo-brutalist React UI design system for humans and coding agents. It provides 61 component contracts, live previews, semantic CSS tokens, light/dark/system themes, accessibility guidance, and an agent-readable registry.

## Start here
- [Homepage](https://neobrutalrivet.github.io/): Overview of the neobrutalism UI design system, visual language, themes, components, and LLM workflow.
- [Component docs](https://neobrutalrivet.github.io/components/): Search and browse all 61 documented UI component contracts.
- [GitHub source](https://github.com/NeoBrutalRivet/NeoBrutal-Rivet): Canonical source repository.
- [Registry](https://github.com/NeoBrutalRivet/NeoBrutal-Rivet/blob/main/registry/manifest.json): Machine-readable component inventory and data-slot contracts.
- [LLM guide](https://github.com/NeoBrutalRivet/NeoBrutal-Rivet/blob/main/docs/LLM-GUIDE.md): Discover-before-invent workflow for coding agents.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/NeoBrutalRivet/NeoBrutal-Rivet/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Project rules for agents working with Rivet.

## Representative component docs
- [Button](https://neobrutalrivet.github.io/components/button/): Buttons and action styling.
- [Input](https://neobrutalrivet.github.io/components/input/): Text input contract and guidance.
- [Dialog](https://neobrutalrivet.github.io/components/dialog/): Modal dialog contract and accessibility guidance.
- [Sidebar](https://neobrutalrivet.github.io/components/sidebar/): Application navigation sidebar contract.
- [Combobox](https://neobrutalrivet.github.io/components/combobox/): Searchable selection component contract.
- [Table](https://neobrutalrivet.github.io/components/table/): Tabular content contract.

## Project vocabulary
- Primary topics: neo-brutalism UI, neobrutalism design system, React UI components, design tokens, dark mode, accessible component patterns, LLM-readable UI registry.
- Product name: NeoBrutal Rivet.
- Identifier: neobrutal-rivet.
- Status: public alpha.
- Tagline: Designed for humans. Structured for machines.
